ai_configure_an_explicit_provider_freeze: Configure an explicit provider, freeze actual profiler evidence, review the exact payload, then approve this one request. No files, environment, keychain or old settings are searched.
ai_credential_is_masked_and_cleared_when: Credential is masked and cleared when sending/cancelling. It is not saved. Memory clearing is best effort, not guaranteed zeroization of SDK/TLS copies.
ai_i_approve_sending_this_exact_request_: I approve sending this exact request to the frozen endpoint
ai_i_approve_uploading_every_displayed_s: I approve uploading every displayed source candidate/path/snippet
ai_select_actual_profiler_evidence_using: Select actual profiler evidence using its AI analysis action. Nothing can be sent without evidence.
ai_optional_question_placeholder: Optional question — included in the frozen payload
ai_https_api_base_url_placeholder: HTTPS API base URL (or loopback HTTP)
ai_the_json_above_is_the_exact_frozen: The JSON above is the exact frozen request body; Authorization is added separately from the temporary secret. Config edits do not change this frozen request. Freeze again to apply edits.
ai_this_evidence_request_was_consumed_or: This evidence request was consumed or cancelled. Select fresh profiler evidence to start another run.
ai_waiting_for_validated_response_cancel: Waiting for validated response… Cancel stops publication and drops transport work.
